One-click installers, a skill store, offline mode.","id":"gh:1351845049","install_available":false,"language":"Python","name":"BioDSH","slug":"sagirimo/BioDSH","topics":["ai-agent","bioinformatics","deepseek","deepseek-harness","desktop-app","dsh-plugin","llm-agent","single-cell","tauri"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"The bioinformatics agent desktop for clinicians and wet-lab scientists — built on DeepSeek Harness. "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"One-click installers, a skill store, offline mode."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"**A bioinformatics agent for clinicians and wet-lab scientists. Describe the analysis in plain langu"},{"id":"p2s2","text":"age and get the result, with no coding.**"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文 · Download · dsh plugin · Results"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"You add your data (single-cell `h5ad`, count matrices, clinical tables, gene lists…) and ask a quest"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ion such as *"Do responders and non-responders differ in CD8A expression?"* The agent loads the data"},{"id":"p4s3","text":", picks the right method, writes and runs the code, and reports the conclusion along with the figure"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"s, the tables and every step it took."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"BioDSH runs on your own computer and is built on DeepSeek Harness (dsh). It comes in two forms: a on"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"e-click **desktop app** and a **dsh plugin** (`dsh-biodsh`)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"BioDSH 1.0 skill hub (preview; catalog entries and counts are illustrative). Interactive preview"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why BioDSH"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Plain language in, conclusions out.** You don't need to write code or set up an environment. A P"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ython analysis environment (scanpy, anndata, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib…) installs itself on fi"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"rst launch.
- **Validated methods instead of improvised code.** It ships 17 official analysis skills"},{"id":"p8s4","text":": single-cell QC, clustering, annotation and treatment response; bulk RNA-seq with limma-voom; Kapla"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"n–Meier and Cox survival; regression with robust standard errors; ANOVA designs; and more. The stati"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"stics skills were checked against R on tens of thousands of cases (for example, 101,587 survival com"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"parisons with zero mismatches).
- **The right skill picked automatically.** For each request, a mode"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"l selects the one or two relevant skills from the 17 official skills and a library of 2,000+ communi"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"ty skills, and loads only those, so the context stays small. Community skills are scanned, and those"},{"id":"p8s10","text":" that ship benchmark answers are excluded.
- **Frontier-level accuracy from an inexpensive model.** "},{"id":"p8s11","text":"With DeepSeek V4 Flash, BioDSH matches Claude Code driven by Opus on our 120-task benchmark (102 vs "},{"id":"p8s12","text":"103) at about a third of the API-equivalent cost (see Results).
- **Long analyses always finish.** A"},{"id":"p8s13","text":" convergence guard keeps the agent from running in circles. It first asks the agent to wrap up, then"},{"id":"p8s14","text":" asks for a final answer, so you always get a result.
- **Your data stays safe.** Original files are"},{"id":"p8s15","text":" never modified, and every analysis writes into a new folder. In offline mode BioDSH talks only to a"},{"id":"p8s16","text":" model on your own machine or intranet, which suits hospitals and labs.
- **Every result can be trac"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"ed.** Every step goes into an append-only session log that you can review, export or hand to a revie"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"wer.
- **Reusable workflows.** You can save a finished analysis as a workflow and rerun it on new da"},{"id":"p8s19","text":"ta. BioDSH can also build a workflow from an existing script, notebook or methods paragraph.
- **You"},{"id":"p8s20","text":"r choice of model.** BioDSH works with DeepSeek's official API, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or a"},{"id":"p8s21","text":" local or intranet model, and you can configure several of them side by side."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Download"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Version | Platform | Get it |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| **1.0.0** (latest) | Windows 10/11 | `BioDSH_1.0.0_x64-setup.exe` |
| **1.0.0** (latest) | macOS 1"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"2+ (Apple silicon) | `BioDSH_1.0.0_aarch64.dmg` |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Upgrading from 0.3.0:** installed 0.3.0 apps are not auto-updated to 1.0; install 1.0.0 over it "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"when you are ready. Your projects, files and conversations are never deleted, but conversations reco"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"rded with 0.3.0 may not open in 1.0.
- **Windows:** on first run, click *More info → Run anyway*. Th"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"e installer is not code-signed.
- **macOS:** the app is not notarized, so macOS may report it as "da"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"maged". Move it to Applications and run `sudo xattr -cr /Applications/BioDSH.app` once."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The stable app checks for updates in the background and installs them with one click. Updates are si"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"gnature-verified, and the app sends no data when it checks."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Use it inside DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"If you already use dsh, you can install the BioDSH agent as a plugin without the desktop app:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"You can also install it from the dsh web UI: **Plugins → Install → `dsh-biodsh`**. Restart dsh, then"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" pick **BioDSH** in the agent preset menu. Your other presets are left unchanged. The plugin require"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"s dsh 0.2.1+ and pnpm. For details, see `packages/dsh-biodsh`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"If you only want the skills, the official skills are plain dsh `SKILL.md` folders. `./scripts/instal"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"l-into-dsh.sh <your-project>/.agents/skills` copies them in (use `install-into-dsh.ps1` on Windows)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Results"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"From our preprint (*arXiv link coming*). The benchmark is BioDSH-Bench-120: 120 analysis tasks in 10"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" subdomains, graded by replaying each submitted script against a public table contract, with no LLM "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"judge. Every agent runs in the same read-isolated sandbox, one run per configuration."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Same model, different agent: a tie.** With every agent on DeepSeek V4 Flash:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Agent (DeepSeek V4 Flash) | Correct / 120 |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| BioDSH + blind second analysis | 102 |
| DeepSeek Harness without BioDSH | 101 |
| BioDSH | 98 |
|"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" Codex CLI | 98 |
| Claude Code | 96 |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"No pairwise difference is statistically significant."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**The model matters more than the agent.** With their own models, Codex ranges from 76 to 116 and Cl"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"aude Code from 95 to 103. On BixBench-Verified-50, run behind a network allow-list, all four agents "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"95 to 103. On BixBench-Verified-50, run behind a network allow-list, all four agents score 33–34/50."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"What BioDSH adds is therefore not accuracy on the same model but the environment around it: a deskto"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"p app, vetted skills, isolated and auditable runs, and a choice of local or remote models."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"**A note on benchmark contamination.** Coding agents read whatever files they can reach and look ans"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"wers up online, and several widely shared community skills ship benchmark answers. BioDSH's skill li"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"brary is scanned for this, and the contaminated skills we found are excluded (`dsh-biodsh` 1.0.0-pre"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"or this, and the contaminated skills we found are excluded (`dsh-biodsh` 1.0.0-preview.2 and later)."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Build from source"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"You need Node.js 22+, stable Rust and the Tauri prerequisites."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| Path | Contents |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| `desktop/` | The desktop app: React UI (`src/`), Rust backend (`src-tauri/`) and build scripts. |
"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"| `packages/dsh-biodsh/` | The `dsh-biodsh` plugin: BioDSH presets, skill selection and the converge"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"nce guard. |
| `biodsh-core/skills/` | Official skills. |"}],"truncated":true}
